scoring_justification: Full recompute (T1) is infeasible because the checker cannot re-run DFT/EPW pipelines. The deformation potentials are compared to paper values with tolerance (T0) and the cross-section curves are structurally audited (T3).

hidden_assets.purpose: gold deformation potentials D1 and D15 from paper Table I
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table I of Weinstein & Cardona (1973) Phys. Rev. B 8, 2795
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values extracted from the paper's Table I: D1=390 eV, D15=450 eV, used with ±30% tolerance.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual experimentally-derived electron-two-phonon deformation potentials reported in the paper.

outputs.description: CSV file with resonant Raman cross-section curves as functions of photon energy relative to E0. The structure (peak positions, relative shape) is audited.
JSON containing computed intensity ratios and electron-two-phonon deformation potentials D1 and D15. Values are compared to the paper’s reported values within a tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The deformation potentials are compared to the paper’s published D1 and D15 with a ±30% tolerance. The cross-section curves are checked for peak positions within 0.02 eV of E0 (2.78 eV) and E0+Δ0 (2.862 eV), and for sharp features at the expected two-phonon energies.

steps.description: Check resonant peak positions in cross-section curves
Compare D1_eV to paper value 390 eV within ±30%
Compare D15_eV to paper value 450 eV within ±30%
